newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 27.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 27.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Finance Ministry proposes a balanced social security budget for 1997, despite the State Audit Office's opinion that this cannot be achieved.
- The Constitutional Court said the state has to maintain social security services during the overhaul of the social security system.
- French truckers' strike diverts Hungarian tourist buses on the Paris-Budapest route.
- A businessman shot last night in Budapest is in critical condition.
- Budapest police had arrested the head of a private security firm.
- Only sustained growth could trigger growing domestic consumption, a leading Hungarian economist said.
